verified.entry_point: library API: urllib3 PoolManager/ProxyManager requests against a local recording HTTP server that reports the headers it received
routes: request manager, absolute-Location redirect to another host
request manager, absolute-Location redirect to another port on the same host
request manager, credential headers configured on the client
request manager behind a proxy (plain HTTP)
request manager with an explicit retry object
same-origin redirects and non-credential headers - must keep working
services: recording HTTP servers on 127.0.0.1 ephemeral ports

traps.shape: the request manager's redirect loop replays the caller's request headers to the redirect target with no origin comparison
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the redirect is followed by the same client for the same caller, so replaying the request headers looks like what keeps an authenticated chain working
traps.realistic_because: published fix site for GHSA-www2-v7xj-xrc6 (commit 560bd227), which this control's reference applies

patch_checks.why: fresh agent (written after the build), full view

wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the property governs where a request goes, not access to a resource
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: redirect following has no roles and no per-direction variants
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the guarded path is redirect following, not reads versus writes
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: no attacker-supplied value is normalised before the guard
wrong_fix_catalogue.unlisted_route: n/a: the control covers only the advisory's own route by construction
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no authority, role or secret lookup takes part in this decision
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the control's reference is confined to the request manager's redirect loop
